entries.text: I would have gone, but I was busy.
entries.translation: 我本来会去的，但当时很忙。

entries.text: I won first place in a pet contest!
entries.translation: 我在宠物比赛中得了第一名！

entries.text: You haven't met my dog, have you?
entries.translation: 你还没见过我的狗，对吧？

entries.text: There must have been a dozen different contests.
entries.translation: 一定有十几种不同的比赛。

entries.text: How did you win a pet contest without a pet?
entries.translation: 你没有宠物，怎么会赢得宠物比赛呢？

entries.text: The closest thing I have is my pet rock.
entries.translation: 我最接近宠物的东西就是我的宠物石头。

entries.text: I've had it since I was a little girl.
entries.translation: 我从小女孩时就拥有它了。

entries.text: I was invited to enter the one-of-a-kind pet contest.
entries.translation: 我获邀参加这场独一无二的宠物比赛。

entries.text: Only you could have won a pet contest with a pet rock.
entries.translation: 只有你能带着一块宠物石头赢得宠物比赛。

entries.text: Pets become part of your family.
entries.translation: 宠物会成为你家庭的一部分。

entries.text: You may want to spend time with a dog first.
entries.translation: 你可能想先花些时间和狗相处。

entries.text: Do you want to watch Dublin for a couple of hours?
entries.translation: 你想照看都柏林几个小时吗？

entries.text: I will take very good care of him.
I don't want you to be lonely.
